job.source_selection: All original33 three-player games; no outcome-based inclusion

social_tie_audit.off_path: Initial prior conditioned on own type and own private answers when counterfactual reach is zero; no formal sequential-equilibrium claim
social_tie_audit.convention: Among own-optimal offer responses, support only responses maximizing other-player utility; remaining admissible action ties may mix nonuniformly at every decision

certificate.off_path: Initial prior conditioned on own type and own private answers when counterfactual reach is zero; no formal sequential-equilibrium claim
certificate.information: Public action history + own preferences + own private query answers; perfect recall
certificate.selection_contract: Deterministic complete contingent BR candidates retain the response-only social tie rule; final joint behavioral mixing may be nonuniform among remaining admissible actions; complete-tree private-information-conditioned BR checks and local own-optimal support audits accept only epsilon-Nash profiles under the declared off-path convention
certificate.scope: Numerically certified own-utility epsilon-Nash profile of this explicitly enumerated cutoff game; no unique or original-game terminal equilibrium claim

native_audit.leaf_objective: Own native goal utility from commitments already made at cutoff; no continuation value

metrics.information: current-node omission, not pre-answer acquisition value

config.operation: Supplement existing candidate labels with exact fixed-reference sparse omission profiles
config.prune: Only exact zero incoming counterfactual mass at opponents; retain every focal action; no probability tolerance
config.endpoint: Native terminal; zero-contribution stubs are NOT heuristic/truncated terminal evaluations
config.full_Q: Reuse old labels with hash and prior independent reference audit; no global BR recomputation
config.S: Every old omission S and saved root policy must match new DP
